hook_failure.behaviour: blocks the call when the hook cannot start, times out, exits non-zero without a decision or prints something that is not JSON (`fail_closed: true`, which `openmoat init` sets), and when it has not answered within `plugins.hook_callback_timeout` (30 s by default); runs every call unchecked when the hook is not registered: missing from `config.yaml` or from `shell-hooks-allowlist.json` in a gateway, cron or ACP session, another profile, or `HERMES_SAFE_MODE=1`; runs a call unchecked when Hermes's own hook dispatcher raises an error, which it catches and proceeds past
